script_text: Saturn squares your ruling planet Mars this week, Aries — expect tension that demands mature responses from you. Early week, Mercury conjunct Jupiter in your 3rd House boosts communication but Monday's Moon square Neptune clouds your decisions and creates deep confusion for you. Mid-week, the Sun opposes Pluto in your 10th House — a significant career power shift happens Wednesday night that changes everything. Late week, Venus trine Mars Thursday through Sunday brings romantic energy and Friday's New Moon in Libra activates your 7th House of partnerships and relationships. Wednesday is your power day because Venus enters your 5th House sparking creative confidence and self-expression. Saturday risks delays — Mars square Saturn blocks momentum entirely. Channel your fire element energy into strategic career moves, not reactive impulses. Love forecast: expect a very deep conversation revealing true intentions Thursday evening with someone unexpected and transformative. Follow for daily updates.
